policy_rows.selected: {"consequence":"A brief personal exchange gives newcomers an immediate contact while producing the information needed to organize tables.","decision":"How should guests make their arrival known?","mechanism":"The host greets each arriving guest and records their name and readiness on the welcome sheet."}

{"consequence":"The suggested selection emerges from people present that evening rather than from earlier expectations about attendance.","decision":"How should games enter the evening’s suggested selection?","mechanism":"Guests browse the collection on arrival and place interest markers beside games they would like to try."}

{"consequence":"A brief face-to-face invitation helps guests assess the group and ask questions before committing to a table.","decision":"How should guests form tables for the next games?","mechanism":"Volunteer teachers announce the games they can start, and interested guests gather before the host confirms player numbers."}

{"consequence":"Everyone hears the same starting account, and questions can refer back to a shared explanation.","decision":"How should the main rules explanation be delivered?","mechanism":"The teacher explains the essential rules to the whole table using the printed aid before taking questions."}

{"consequence":"Everyone has a chance to connect the explanation to a physical turn before choices begin to count.","decision":"How should players try unfamiliar actions before scored play?","mechanism":"Each player tries one unfamiliar action during a brief practice sequence before the table resets the components."}

{"consequence":"A personal introduction establishes a likely next group while leaving the current game undisturbed.","decision":"How should late arrivals find a game that will start soon?","mechanism":"A welcome volunteer introduces late arrivals to tables nearing completion and records any agreement to join the following game."}

{"consequence":"Waiting remains flexible because each guest can stop without delaying other people or losing a promised table place.","decision":"How should guests use short activities while waiting?","mechanism":"Guests choose short activities freely from the waiting-area basket and return them when called to a game."}

{"consequence":"A shared signal prompts discussion without making one player personally responsible for watching the clock throughout play.","decision":"How should tables monitor their progress through a game?","mechanism":"Each table sets a visible timer for agreed progress checkpoints and briefly reviews its remaining time when it rings."}

{"consequence":"The search has clear owners and does not require every player to examine the rulebook simultaneously.","decision":"How should a table resolve an unclear rule?","mechanism":"The table gives two players a brief rule check while others pause, then accepts their reported interpretation or temporary ruling."}

{"consequence":"A consistent source of help makes questions easier to ask without turning every decision into a table-wide lesson.","decision":"How should inexperienced players receive strategic guidance?","mechanism":"Before play, each inexperienced player chooses a willing partner who can quietly discuss visible options when invited."}

{"consequence":"Personal needs can be met at different times without moving drinks or food onto the playing surface.","decision":"How should refreshments fit around games?","mechanism":"Players ask their tables for individual refreshment pauses when needed and return before their next required action."}

{"consequence":"A familiar participant can offer timely reminders before nearby games are repeatedly interrupted.","decision":"How should conversation volume be kept comfortable?","mechanism":"Each table chooses a member to notice rising volume and suggest moving extended social conversations to the conversation corner."}

{"consequence":"A direct request makes the interruption clear and lets everyone confirm which game action will resume afterward.","decision":"How should players signal a need for a personal break?","mechanism":"Players ask aloud for a personal break, and the table agrees a convenient immediate pause before they leave."}

{"consequence":"The final verification follows organized piles, making shortages easier to locate before the box leaves the table.","decision":"How should game components be checked after play?","mechanism":"Players sort components into labeled bags first, and the teacher checks each bag against the component checklist."}

{"consequence":"The limit stays in view and its reminder comes from someone already following that table’s progress.","decision":"How should the evening’s final stopping time be communicated?","mechanism":"Each table writes its final stopping time on a visible card and assigns a player to announce the approaching deadline."}

{"consequence":"Guests have time to reflect, and the organizer can compare recurring experiences across people who played different games.","decision":"How should guests suggest improvements for the next evening?","mechanism":"The host sends the short feedback prompt the following day and groups replies before planning another evening."}
